head: 89de9af4b631abdef5673ce8949fb02a32f6fcad

M9-DEV-084: Range/toggle/select-all did not forward first selected file. Both shared prototype and production now forward only one eligible file while retaining selection/focus; tree opens opt out of programmatic reveal. Empty selection is separate from active file.

Native directory refresh could remove old DOM focus between a keyboard target update and its RAF. r34 actual focus remains lost after10s; deterministic after-native-return red reproduces it. Restore latest authenticated per-root logical target, preserve external user-focus precedence.

Affected r35 regression found browser scroll clamp during loading could erase viewport after opening a visible file. Capture last user position before clamp and reuse readiness-based pending restore; later user wheel cancels. Native red/green pair and fresh r36 App viewport validate.

basis: The predevelopment06 table sets a local root-list feasibility check below1000ms for its6000-file fixture. This is a new pre-execution E1 engineering budget for the B13 10000/10001 fixture, not a retroactive claim that the old measurement covered10000.
The App bound adds1000ms for pointer/IPC/render and bounded state polling. Native-I/jsdom aggregate is checked separately, never substituted for App latency.
100 DOM items is an independent upper budget for the approximately900px test window, rather than asserting the exact implementation formula. All entries still must be present and tail readable.

64MiB is the initial directory-tree incremental JS heap budget;128MiB includes first editor load/tail selection. Record raw no-forced-GC samples and actual viewport. No cold-cache, long-term leak or all-device SLA claim.
budget.changePolicy: Retain E1 and any failures. Do not silently loosen thresholds or count truncation as complete; investigate or document a justified follow-up budget separately.

largeTreeRegression.boundaries: Original E1 unchanged. Initial four P runs overlap build/U-I and are functional diagnostics only; final same-script P runs solo. Final App large runs last in serial batch after CPU tests/build complete. Raw JS heap, warm generated filesystem, not native RSS/cold cache/leak SLA.

boundaries: A uses original packaged renderer/native/IPC. Public synthetic project/profile/task setup only; real input-only receiver has same pid/PTY and0 input bytes. No model, system clipboard, AIS, old r4/r6 pending57 bytes or daily resources.

Exact first-file native call accounting is I; actual A confirms one active preview, independent focus/selection, empty selection, modifier/key inputs and single-target menus. macOS passing pointer tests use Meta; native Ctrl-click correctly opened context menu in the preserved P attempt. I exercises generic Control branch; no Windows/Linux or global system shortcut claim.

P is full shared FileWorkspace with own synthetic state and explicit P/only-file-area badge. Default prototype files are hidden only in the B22 fixture scope; ordinary prototype behavior remains unchanged. Unknown reference Enter/Space/keyboard-menu and complete B17 R/P/A remain open.

Regression drivers retain declared boundaries: own CSS-delayed viewport, read-only observations, deterministic cache with only own observed watch IDs paused. These are not labelled unmodified environment observations.

r34 source snapshot precedes task-theme/wait driver corrections and new focus regression test; all versions/results preserved. r36 build/final951 match,81 assets verified; native binary unchanged since r33. Fresh46 are the affected modules; cumulative1710 is historical union, not a fresh full suite.
